terms.gloss: the ring of a telephone: a ringtone
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase for a telephone’s ring (p. 391); no reference work has a separate word for a ringtone. A plain description also serves: the phone rings with sonāre (see the phone is ringing; Andresian p. 14), so the sound it rings with is its sonus.

terms.register: vōx poētica: Verg., Ov.; in ōrātiōne solūtā post Augustum (Sen., Plin.)
terms.comment: Classically the ring of bronze and cymbals: the noun of Traupman’s phrase, enough by itself where the phone is understood.

sources: Lewis & Short: sonus · Lewis & Short: tinnitus
Anna Andresian, Vocabula Picta (2014), p. 14: sonō for a ringing phone.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 391.

phrases.english: the sound of the phone: its ringtone
